title: Pure Morganite
summary: The Morganite archetype (Time-Tearing Morganite, Succumbing-Song Morganite, Guilt-Gripping Morganite, and their Spellcaster tutor Morgana the Witch of Eyes) permanently rewrites the rules of the Duel! In exchange for not activating monster effects in your hand, Time-Tearing Morganite lets you draw 2 cards per Draw Phase and conduct 2 Normal Summons per turn; Succumbing-Song Morganite searches any 'Morganite' card and makes your monsters deal double battle damage + attack monsters twice; and Guilt-Gripping Morganite lets you Normal Summon Level 5+ monsters with 0 Tributes and activate Normal Traps without paying LP! Because you cannot activate monster handtraps, you pair Morgana the Witch of Eyes with high-impact field-effect monsters like Vanity's Fiend, Majesty's Fiend, and Inspector Boarder—Normal Summoning two floodgate bosses in a single turn with zero Tributes!

allow.Vanity's Fiend: Level 6 DARK Fiend (2400 ATK) that prevents BOTH players from Special Summoning monsters; under Guilt-Gripping Morganite and Time-Tearing Morganite, you can Normal Summon Vanity's Fiend with ZERO Tributes as one of your 2 Normal Summons per turn!
allow.Majesty's Fiend: Level 6 LIGHT Fiend (2400 ATK) that prevents monster effects from being activated anywhere; Normal Summons with ZERO Tributes under Guilt-Gripping Morganite and has no hand effects that conflict with Morganite!
allow.Inspector Boarder: Level 4 LIGHT Machine (2000 ATK) that locks down monster effect activations on the field while you rely on permanent Duel-long Morganite Spell effects.
allow.Thunder King Rai-Oh: Level 4 LIGHT Thunder (1900 ATK) that prevents either player from adding cards from Deck to hand and tributes itself to negate any Special Summon.
allow.Solemn Judgment: Limited to 1 in TCG: iconic Counter Trap that costs ZERO LP under Guilt-Gripping Morganite!
allow.Solemn Strike: Counter Trap that negates monster effects or Special Summons for ZERO LP under Guilt-Gripping Morganite.
allow.Solemn Warning: Counter Trap that negates Summons or effects that Special Summon for ZERO LP under Guilt-Gripping Morganite.

main: Morgana the Witch of Eyes
Signature Level 4 DARK Spellcaster (1500 ATK / 2100 DEF): when Normal or Special Summoned, adds ANY 'Morganite' Spell from your Deck to your hand; and reduces opposing monsters' ATK to 0!
Time-Tearing Morganite

Core Normal Spell: for the rest of this Duel, you cannot activate monster effects in the hand, you draw 2 cards instead of 1 during each Draw Phase, and you can conduct up to 2 Normal Summons/Sets each turn!
Succumbing-Song Morganite

Core Normal Spell: for the rest of this Duel, you cannot activate monster effects in the hand, monsters you control can make up to 2 attacks on monsters, and battle damage inflicted is DOUBLED; banishes itself to search ANY 'Morganite' card!
Guilt-Gripping Morganite

Core Normal Spell: for the rest of this Duel, you cannot activate monster effects in the hand, you can Normal Summon Level 5 or higher monsters WITHOUT Tributing, and you do not pay LP to activate Spell/Trap Cards!
Vanity's Fiend
2400 ATK Level 6 Fiend (Normal Summoned with 0 Tributes via Guilt-Gripping Morganite and alongside Morgana via Time-Tearing Morganite!): neither player can Special Summon monsters.
Majesty's Fiend
2400 ATK Level 6 Fiend (Normal Summoned with 0 Tributes via Guilt-Gripping Morganite!): monster effects cannot be activated.
Inspector Boarder
2000 ATK Level 4 Machine that restricts monster effect activations on the field while your Morganite Spells remain active for the entire Duel without needing monster effects.
Thunder King Rai-Oh
Level 4 LIGHT Thunder (1900 ATK): stops searching and tributes itself to negate any Special Summon.
Solemn Judgment
Limited to 1 in TCG: negates any Summon or Spell/Trap activation for ZERO LP under Guilt-Gripping Morganite!
Solemn Strike
Negates any monster effect or Special Summon for ZERO LP while Guilt-Gripping Morganite is active!
Solemn Warning
Negates Summons or effects that Special Summon for ZERO LP under Guilt-Gripping Morganite.
